hints.title: What are the choices at each index?
hints.body: At each value, you can either take it or skip it. If you take it, what does that force you to do with the previous index?

hints.title: Track two best sums
hints.body: Keep the best sum when the previous index was taken, and the best sum when it was skipped. Taking the current value can only extend the skipped state.

hints.title: Two-variable recurrence
hints.body: Let `take` be the best sum ending with the current value taken, and `skip` the best sum ending with it skipped. For each value: `nextTake = skip + value`, `nextSkip = max(skip, take)`. Return `max(take, skip)` at the end.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
take = 0
skip = 0
for value in values:
    next_take = skip + value
    next_skip = max(skip, take)
    take = next_take
    skip = next_skip
return max(take, skip)
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Translate it into your language and check it against the examples.
